raw_segments.text: And suddenly, a strange, surprising sensation of a sort of bitter hatred for
As it were wondering and frightened of this sensation,
he raised his head and looked intently at her.
But he met her uneasy and painfully anxious eyes fixed on him.
His hatred vanished like a phantom.
It was not the real feeling.
He had taken the one feeling for the other.
It only meant that that minute had come.
